lines.zh: (学生中心门口的海报,最上面一行大字)国际学生之夜!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Friday night, 6:00 to 9:00, at the Student Center.

lines.speaker: narrator

grammar.titleZh: 读海报:省略句、时间和地点
grammar.bodyZh: 海报为了醒目,常常只写关键词,省掉主语和动词:Free!(= It's free!)、From China: Lei's spicy Sichuan food!、Friday night, 6:00 to 9:00(= It's on Friday night, from 6:00 to 9:00.)。读的时候自己把意思补全。复习时间和地点的介词:钟点前用 at(at 7:30),星期前用 on(on Friday),在某个地方用 at(at the Student Center)。海报上的 Can you sing, dance, or cook? 是在找人来表演,这里的 can 是“会”。

examples.text: It's free! All students are welcome.
examples.zh: 免费入场!欢迎所有学生。

examples.text: At 7:30, listen to Marcus on the guitar.
examples.zh: 7 点半,来听马库斯弹吉他。

examples.text: Can you dance? Join the show!
examples.zh: 你会跳舞吗?来参加演出吧!
